scope: Verify the source-derived L2 walking step boundary and rerun the full repository runtime suite against the installed L2 bundle.

referenceRule.rule: Walking steps up at most four pixels; a five-pixel obstruction causes a turn.
referenceRule.limit: The installed app bundle contains L2 data but not the original DOS executable or PROCESS overlay. This run validates the native implementation against the recorded source-derived rule; it is not a new DOS comparison.

cases.expected: advance one pixel and rise four pixels
stay in place, turn, remain walking

validation.result: Full L2 runtime suite passed. The new four/five-pixel boundary regression passed. All 120 bundled campaign levels loaded and advanced, and all 120 recorded campaign completion replays passed.

closureEffect: Closes a source-derived walking-step boundary regression gap. It does not close broad DOS gameplay parity, ark completion, campaign ending or full-app release validation.
